hooks.command: python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath') or ''; print(f) if f.endswith('.py') else None" | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ]; then ruff check --fix "$f" && ruff format "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
